outcome_evidence: The oven is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 80–100, image and left_ego_image). The door remains visibly open with the interior exposed through frame 120 as the gripper withdraws (image and left_ego_image; wrist_image shows the withdrawal near the tabletop). No failed acquisition or unintended object displacement is visibly established.
